description: Repair and restoration of scullery wing and erection of a part single storey rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until details of all new external doors, door frames, window frames and glazing bars, including samples if so required, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such details shall indicate, at a scale of not less than 1:20, the longitudinal and cross-sectional detailing of new windows, cill and lintel detailing, and means of opening. All new window frames, glazing bars and external door frames shall be of timber construction and white painted, with (if any) trickle vents concealed, and be retained as such thereafter. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until a Construction Method Statement (CMS) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CMS shall be certified by a qualified professional and give details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area. The approved CMS shall be adhered to throughout the construction period for the development.
